A protective service designed to help reduce damage caused by moisture, road debris, and harsh driving conditions.

The underside of your vehicle is constantly exposed to water, dirt, salt, and road debris.

Over time, these conditions can contribute to corrosion and wear, especially in areas exposed to harsh environments.

Underbody Coating & Protection at HyperAuto Care adds an extra protective layer to help maintain vulnerable areas and support long-term vehicle care.


A practical service for owners who want additional protection beyond regular exterior care.

  • Help protect vehicles frequently exposed to rain and moisture.

  • Add protection for vehicles exposed to dirt, mud, and challenging conditions.

  • A good option for drivers planning to keep their vehicles for many years.

  • Protect important areas early before heavy exposure occurs.
